prompts.title: Mustard Yellow Saree Elegance
prompts.prompt: A cinematic, photorealistic medium shot captured from a soft three-quarter angle. Use the attached reference photo for facial identity and preserve facial structure and proportions. A beautiful woman stands gracefully in a lush green garden, looking toward the camera with a gentle, serene smile. She is dressed in an elegant mustard-yellow saree with a rich green embroidered border and a detailed peacock motif on the pallu, paired with a matching blouse. She is adorned with traditional gold jhumka earrings, a choker necklace, a maang tikka, and a small bindi. One hand is raised softly near her hair, while the other rests naturally at her waist, with visible mehendi on her hands. Warm natural sunlight filters through the trees, creating a soft golden glow, gentle highlights on her hair and saree, and a beautifully blurred leafy background with creamy bokeh. The composition keeps her face, jewelry, saree details, and peacock design in sharp focus while softly blurring the background. Aspect ratio 3:4.

prompts.title: Pearls on the Peak
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image as a strict visual identity reference.
The subject’s facial structure, proportions, skin tone, eye shape, nose, lips, jawline, hairline, and overall likeness must remain extremely close to the reference.
No beautification, no reshaping, no stylization, no identity drift. Preserve natural skin texture and realism.

Main Concept
Create a high-fashion, photorealistic editorial portrait of the same woman standing in a snowy mountain landscape under bright daylight, with a cinematic winter atmosphere.

Subject & Face Match
The woman must match the uploaded face as closely as possible:

Same bone structure, cheek shape, jawline, eye spacing, nose bridge, lip fullness

Same skin tone and natural texture

Same expression style and gaze

No face smoothing, no AI beauty filter, no plastic skin

Hairstyle (Must Match Exactly)

Hair styled in two long, symmetrical braids, one on each side

Braids start near the crown and fall forward over the chest

A clean center part

Two thin face-framing strands left loose at the front

Braids are smooth, thick, and neatly woven

Wardrobe & Accessories

Luxurious cream/ivory textured coat made of thick boucle and wool

Subtle pearl detailing and soft fringe accents along the edges

Oversized cascading pearl earrings

Layered pearl necklaces around the neck that softly shimmer in the light

Makeup

Velvety matte skin

Soft peach blush

Defined brows

Warm brown eyeshadow

Muted rose/nude lips

Natural glow, not glossy, not overdone

Lighting & Mood

Bright natural daylight reflected from snow

Cool, diffused light wrapping around the face

Soft highlights on pearls and coat texture

Clean, crisp winter atmosphere

Background

Snow-covered mountains

Clear blue sky

Background softly blurred for depth (shallow depth of field)

Camera & Style

85mm portrait lens look

Shallow depth of field

High-fashion editorial style

Ultra-detailed, photorealistic, cinematic

Aspect ratio 4:5

Final Instruction
The face and hairstyle must stay as close to the uploaded image as possible.
No identity drift. No stylization. Preserve realism.

prompts.title: Timeless Indian Beauty
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-high-resolution, hyper-realistic traditional Indian bridal portrait using the attached reference image as the absolute and exact face identity source.
Subject & Face:

A young woman with a natural, glowing complexion and soft natural features identical to the reference. Almond-shaped light brown eyes, gently arched eyebrows, calm and serene expression. Gaze directed slightly off-camera to her left (viewer’s right). Realistic skin texture with visible pores and natural highlights.
Makeup (Exact Match):

Warm, polished bridal makeup matching the reference: subtle winged eyeliner, softly blended eyeshadow, gentle blush on cheekbones, matte terracotta-to-soft-red lipstick. No exaggerated contouring or stylization.
Hair:

Long, voluminous dark brown hair with lighter brown highlights, styled in loose cascading waves flowing over her right shoulder, extending past the waist. Realistic strand detail and natural movement.
Attire:

Deep crimson red silk saree with heavy gold zari embroidery, dense floral and paisley borders. Blouse with sweetheart neckline and elbow-length sleeves, richly embroidered, including a visible elephant motif surrounded by floral vines. Fabric appears rich, premium, and authentic.
Jewelry & Details:

Traditional Indian bridal gold jewelry: heavy gold choker with filigree and dangling beads, long double-strand mangalsutra with ornate pendant, delicate necklace near the neck, large gold jhumka earrings with pearl drops, stacked red glass and gold bangles on both wrists, multiple gold rings. Circular red alta mark visible on the back of the right hand.
Pose & Composition:

Medium portrait from waist to head, vertical 2:3 aspect ratio. Right hand gently raised near the temple or hairline, left hand resting at the waist. Elegant, relaxed posture.
Background & Lighting:

Ornate traditional backdrop with dense floral textures in rust, deep red, and antique gold. Soft warm cinematic lighting with golden highlights, gentle shadows adding depth. Jewelry and embroidery subtly glow.
Mood & Quality:

Regal, elegant, bridal-festive, timeless Indian beauty. Photorealistic finish, professional portrait photography, shallow depth of field, cinematic warmth, 8K-level detail.

images.alt: Gemini AI Generated Image: a captivating portrait of a young woman dressed in traditional Indian attire, set against a vintage-style floral background in warm, earthen tones. She is wearing a rich, deep crimson saree adorned with intricate gold embroidery, including detailed borders and motifs of elephants. Her look is accessorized with lavish gold jewelry, consisting of a heavy choker, a longer necklace with black beads resembling a mangalsutra, ornate jhumka earrings, and stacks of red and gold bangles on both wrists. Her long, wavy brown hair falls loosely over her shoulders, framing a face with soft, polished makeup and matte reddish-brown lipstick. One hand is elegantly raised near her temple, revealing traditional red dye (alta) on her fingertips, while her expression is calm and direct, creating a mood of classic elegance.
